name: Life-Reading Eyes
body:
Source Agents of Evil pg. 29
Aura moderate divination; CL 7th
Slot eyes; Price 15,000 gp; Weight —
Description
Favored by doctors and torturers alike—especially the paincrafters of Nidal—these jet-black spectacles fully obscure the eyes of the wearer while granting her the ability to peer at the auras of other creatures. The wearer can read the emotion and health auras of any creature as per analyze auraOA while the spectacles are worn, but can perceive only those auras.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, analyze auraOA; Cost 7,500 gp
